semantics.ac_rule: With AccessCore active, governed remote dereference passes through DWH and remote authorization evaluation.
semantics.direct_rule: Direct `$EXT` dereference is disallowed for governed data access while AC is active.
semantics.identity_rule: Remote object/data identity remains owned by its origin/remote schema.
semantics.readonly_rule: Read-only external defaults remain enforced unless explicit remote mutation policy exists.

invariants.rule: DWH data movement preserves explicit origin identity, schema, scope and remote authority boundaries; transport connectivity never becomes data authority.
